zh: Dragon Claw 2.0 Web 基座与技能中心全面支持全员开放/未全员开放权限标识与严密右对齐排版：输入框 @ 技能联想浮层、侧栏「发现应用」搜索弹窗、+ 附加菜单及技能中心卡片均增加双色开放徽章与快捷分类筛选，右侧标签容器消除居中漂移与视觉错乱，超级管理员可全链路把控资产可见范围。
优化 iOS 自动化打包发布机制：在云端构建流水线中加入 Apple 开发者证书智能自动清理功能，构建前自动巡检并清理 CI 临时证书，彻底解决证书配额占满导致的构建中断。
移动端多图卡片滑动交互重构：全面优化 iOS 与 Android 端多图层叠轮播交互，实现自然的滑出飞行过渡与轻量触感反馈，彻底消除滑动切换时图片弹回原位的视觉错觉。
en: Dragon Claw 2.0 Web base and Skill Hub now fully support shared access indicators with strict right-aligned badge columns: chat composer @ skill autocomplete, sidebar Discover Apps modal, plus menu, and Skill Hub cards all display shared/unshared badges and quick category filters for comprehensive distribution control.
Optimize iOS automated release pipeline: introduce automated Apple development certificate pruning before builds, revoking stale ephemeral CI certificates to prevent quota exhaustion.
Refactor mobile stacked image deck swipe physics: implement smooth continuous flight dismissal and subtle haptic feedback across iOS and Android, eliminating the return illusion on card drag.
